name: r4-q4-schedule-gw-shapes
description: Fix Q4 (review A2 L1 and the stored-text sweep): the legacy schedule PUT (osi-irrigation-policy routes.js) answers the zone row as read, zone.zone_uuid || null and zone.gateway_device_eui || String(DEVICE_EUI || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase(): a BLOB is a truthy Buffer, answered as Buffer JSON. lifecycle.js zoneState binds the zone_uuid it read to find the zone's conditional policy: a BLOB zone_uuid matches only a BLOB policy key, never a TEXT one with the same characters (zone 6: no policy, so the write is a legacy write; zone 7: BLOB policy key, so the enabled write is refused as managed). Zone 8 has an empty-BLOB zone_uuid.
